purpose: Prospective untouched holdout integrity after transparent pre-holdout reseal. Previous baseline was superseded because semantic selection/validation drift was found before holdout start.

policy.after_holdout_start: Any semantic change to a contamination-sensitive file contaminates this version. Do not repair in place; create a new version/cohort.
policy.operational_fix_rule: Operational changes are allowed only when they cannot change selection, feature values, labels, execution assumptions, security eligibility, targets/stops, or validation decisions. They must be logged.
policy.pre_holdout_reseal_rule: Before holdout start, material semantic drift requires explicit audit plus transparent reseal or revert. Silent classification as operational is prohibited.
policy.contract_hash_guard: Canonical final-test JSON SHA-256 and protected-file byte drift are enforced by CI.

outcome_contract.same_candle_resolution: 1-minute path when available; otherwise pessimistic stop-first

notes: 2026-09-30 reseal is prospective and occurs before the 2026-10-07 holdout; PREHOLDOUT_RESEAL_REPORT_2026-09-30.md documents the reason.
Historical/discovery evidence before genesis is not untouched OOS.
Yellow weighted discovery is a separate observational cohort and is not allowed to alter frozen V5 membership/statistics.
Passing the research gate permits only tiny-live review; it never authorizes automatic trading.

supersedes.reason: Pre-holdout audit found material selection/validation semantic changes, including Binance 90-day runner eligibility and Gate validation-cohort qualification. Old baseline is not used for the 2026-10-07 untouched holdout.
